label: Grandpa
instruction: A male grandpa, gravelly nasal tenor-baritone, weary and VERY drunk and intoxicated muttering, lazy half-swallowed slurred words, irregular tempo, sharp cynical emphasis, stumbling breath, sudden explosive manic delight.
text: Retirement lasted eleven minutes, then the boredom became unbearable. So I built a pocket-sized arena and started collecting the greatest fighters in every universe.
